question: I don't get the demand shift. Can you show it a simpler way?

steps.title: Drop the curves for a moment
steps.say: Let's forget the curves for a moment and think about a simple market.

steps.title: A simple story
steps.say: Five apples at a market. Then more buyers arrive.

ops.text:
5 apples at the market.
More buyers show up!

steps.title: Buyers bid up the price
steps.say: With the same apples but more buyers, people offer more money. The price goes up.

ops.text:
More buyers,
same apples →
price goes up.

steps.title: Back to the graph
steps.say: On the graph this is the same story: the demand curve slides right, and the price where the curves meet goes up.

ops.text:
On the graph, the demand
curve slides right.
